library.description: Runtime-neutral storage host and typed backend authoring

blocks.text: 把内存、数据库和文件后端装到同一个存储宿主（host），用带类型的 `backend(id)` 获取对应存储，并统一结束工作与释放资源。适合同时使用多个数据源、需要组织隔离或事务的应用：先安装后端插件，再选择各后端提供的能力；多个后端的写入不会自动合成一个原子事务。
English · 使用指南

items: 数据库连接关了，订阅或排队任务还在运行：业务代码没有统一的结束入口。
两个后端都叫 `cache`，调用时才发现拿错实例：字符串查找丢失了安装时的类型信息。
给每个方法手动加租户前缀，偶尔漏掉一次：组织隔离依赖调用方逐项遵守约定。
同时更新文本和记录，一半成功一半失败：多次独立写入没有放进同一个事务。
`backend(id)` 保留已安装插件的具体类型；重复 ID 在安装时拒绝。安装后端
内置 memory 后端可直接存文本、字节和记录，也能执行事务。事务与查询
`org(id)` 固定同一组织，传递给实体或组合插件后仍保持隔离。组织数据
`dispose()` 等待已接纳的工作并释放已安装资源；组织视图没有关闭整个宿主的方法。结束工作

blocks.text: 下面把状态写入 memory，再从同一个后端读取。支持顶层 `await` 的 TypeScript 环境可直接使用。

blocks.code: paid

blocks.text: memory 数据只在当前实例中存在。再次创建宿主不会恢复它。
同样的状态存取，用普通 Map 很容易开始，但组织隔离与退出处理需要另外约定：

blocks.code:
const values = new Map<string, string>()
values.set('order:1:status', 'paid') // 没有组织前缀，不同组织会碰到同一键。
console.log(values.get('order:1:status'))
values.clear() // 只能清数据，不能等待其它异步存储工作。

items: `plugins` 的 ID 必须唯一。一批插件全部成功才会出现在查找结果中；安装失败会释放本批已创建的资源。重叠的 `use`、`unUse` 调用按调用顺序排队执行，前一个结束（无论成功或失败）后才开始下一个。
`autoDetect` 默认 `true`，`installTimeoutMs` 默认 `30000` 毫秒，是每个插件各自的安装时限（同一批中的插件分别计时），`0` 表示不限时。设 `autoDetect: false` 后，应先 `await host.detect()` 再执行数据操作；检查未完成的操作会报 `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`。追加插件后也要检查新增后端。
`org` 默认零 UUID；显式组织 ID 必须是规范的小写 UUID，可用 `createOrgId()` 生成。`org()` 返回的视图不能安装插件、删除组织或关闭宿主。删除组织尝试所有后端，部分失败不会撤回已成功的删除，错误为 `ORG_DELETE_FAILED`，具体失败在 `AggregateError.errors` 中。
后端支持什么能力由实际实例决定。非默认组织不会自动得到只绑定到根后端的自定义能力；先检查 `has(token)`。组织视图不支持原生 SQL/SPARQL 入口。
显式 `dispose()` 的失败会拒绝，重复调用复用同一个 Promise。`await using` 清理会报告失败并完成，以免覆盖业务代码的主错误。调用方提供的原生客户端是否需要单独关闭，见相应后端说明。
宿主错误的 `source` 为 `storage.host`；共享参数和能力错误来自 `storage.contract`。排查时同时读取 `source`、`code` 与 `cause`，不要匹配错误文案。

blocks.text: 子路径已经收敛：原来的 `/authoring/*` 和 `/vector/mmr` 合并为 `/sdk`；`/journal` 改为 `/plugins/journal`；`/entity/<名称>` 改为 `/entity/features/<名称>`；memory 后端从根入口移到 `/plugins/memory`。旧路径直接删除，不保留别名。
应用只调用 `backend()` 时无需导入作者工具。实现后端时，运行时工具从以下入口获取；类型、能力 token、定义和纯校验继续从 contract 获取。
表中的 `/sdk` 均以 `@migaia/storage-host` 开头。

blocks.text: 完整路径和依赖说明见 storage-contract。旧 contract 根入口不保留这些运行时导出。
实体装配变更：`/entity` 提供基础读写。旧版自动包含的查询、索引、unique 检查、迁移和 keyset，现需在 `features` 中声明对应 `/entity/*` 单元；业务只导入需要的单元。缺少时抛出 `ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED`。迁移方式见实体仓储。
基础宿主不导入 journal runtime、通知控制器或变更迭代器。此前宿主的 journal 选项会自动加载日志实现，memory 默认提供变更通知和 watch；现在这些能力由业务显式选择，避免基础存读包含未使用代码。

日志配置写在从 `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal` 导入的 `storageJournalPlugin(options)` 里，放在 `createStorageHost` 第一批插件中、要记录的后端之前；宿主没有单独的 `journal` 选项。后装或重复传入带配置的日志插件会报 `INVALID_CONFIG`。只用 `storageLogStore()` 时装 `storageJournalPlugin()` 即可，缺少插件时报 `JOURNAL_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。配置格式、日志内容和事务提交语义保持原契约。

观察事件只通过 `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/probe` 的 `storageProbe(handlers)` 订阅，宿主没有 `hooks` 选项，也没有 `host.hooks`。probe 放进 `createStorageHost` 的 plugins 时，从这一批的第一个安装事件起就能收到；安装后用 `host.extensions.observe(name, handler)` 追加监听，返回值是退订函数。在非默认组织的视图上调用时只收到该组织的事件。一个宿主只装一个 probe；监听器失败交给 `report`，不改变存储结果。
memory 通知和变更流分别由两个 Feature 装配：

未选择变更流时，memory 的 `capabilities.changeFeed` 为 `false`；调用 watch 报 `CHANGE_ITERATOR_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。只选通知可调用 `subscribeChanges()`；变更流依赖通知，缺少通知时报 `CHANGE_CONTROLLER_NOT_ASSEMBLED`。基础读写与物理资源关闭仍由轻量生命周期 owner 负责。
后端作者从 `/sdk` 导入通知工厂，并显式传给 `core.createChangeController(options, createBackendChangeController)`。基础物理资源可使用同入口的 `createBackendLifecycleController`。变更迭代器也从同一个 `/sdk` 入口导入。

旧版 `.index(...).requirePushdown()` 在没有客户端步骤时允许全表扫描。现在显式索引来源若为 `fullScan`，或原生索引准备遇到竞争而只能扫描，终端读取会拒绝 `@migaia/storage-contract / QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE`。需要原生索引时同时装配 `entityIndexesFeature()` 和后端索引 Feature；允许权威扫描时移除 `requirePushdown()`。普通查询继续保留扫描回退。IndexedDB 的借用视图与原生 store 共用能力身份；未迁移的旧格式记录使 readiness 保持 running；查询继续全表扫描并发出回退诊断，直到迁移状态完成且与当前定义一致。

blocks.text: 初始插件放在 `plugins` 数组中。后续 `use()` 返回带新增后端类型的宿主；两者共享同一个生命周期，关闭其中一个宿主引用一次即可。
同一批次里的插件不能借用彼此尚未发布的后端。缓存、归档等组合插件需要读取已有后端时，应先完成基础后端安装，再 `use()` 安装组合插件。ID 必须在整个宿主中唯一。
`autoDetect` 默认开启。需要先完成配置再检查环境时，可设置 `autoDetect: false`，随后显式 `detect()`。并发检查共享同一个 Promise；成功结果会缓存，失败后可再次调用。`installTimeoutMs` 是整批安装的毫秒上限，默认 `30000`，允许有限非负数。安装失败会回滚本批资源，不删除早先已成功安装的后端。
memory 的文本、字节和记录可以在同一个事务中写入。回调失败时草稿不提交。查询从 `records` 能力取得，下面在事务结束后读取已提交记录。
memory 的记录过滤在客户端执行。换用数据库后端时，下推能力和事务范围由该后端决定。事务可能因冲突重放回调；不要在回调中发送邮件、扣款或执行其它无法随事务回滚的副作用。
同一逻辑键的文本、字节和记录有通道冲突规则。需要替换已有通道时，应明确选择相应写入策略，不把三种值当成互不相干的键空间。批量写入的重复键会在提交前拒绝；批量删除的重复键只计一次。
`/entity` 现在只包含定义、连接和基础读写。附加能力需从独立子路径显式装配；缺少装配时抛出 `source: @migaia/storage-host`、`code: ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED`，消息写明所需导入。

只在 `features` 中选择用到的单元：`/entity/features/query` 的 `entityQueryFeature()` 开启 query/list/stream；`/entity/features/indexes` 的 `entityIndexesFeature()` 开启索引声明和规划；`/entity/features/unique` 的 `entityUniqueFeature()` 开启唯一提交检查；`/entity/features/migration` 的 `entityMigrationFeature()` 开启版本计划和持久迁移；`/entity/features/keyset` 的 `entityKeysetFeature()` 准入 page/after。索引查询与唯一约束的回退校验还需要 query。没有索引或唯一约束的迁移直接扫描原生记录或文本键，不需要 query 或 unique。单元不会自动开启其他单元。
unique 单元能单独捕获约束投影，不会因此开启索引规划；仅做唯一写入检查时不需 indexes 单元。
`defineEntity<T>()({...})` 声明对象的主键与索引，`connect(store)` 连接实际后端。下面先写入，再用同一声明查询。
实体不会关闭传入的后端。事务中使用 `orders.in(tx)`；`orders.batch(...)` 使用一个原生记录事务。schema 与 codec 用于运行时校验和转换，TypeScript 类型本身不校验外部输入。需要外部 schema 时，可从同一 `/entity` 入口使用 `fromStandardSchema`；转换失败保留原错误在 `cause` 中。

查询的 `index` 或 `range` 要最先选择，且只能选一次；普通 `where`、`select`、`skip`、`limit` 会产生新分支。自定义比较器应搭配有限 `limit`，或使用 `first()`。`stream()` 返回可释放迭代器；提前停止时使用 `await using` 或显式 `dispose()`。`watch()` 是可用后端的失效通知，并非结果行流，也不保证重放。事务查询没有 `watch()`。
迁移没有索引或唯一约束的记录时，只需选择 migration 单元。读取旧记录会升级返回值；需要持久化新版本信封时，再调用 `migrate()`。内存记录的每个迁移批次沿用原生事务。
声明唯一约束时仍需选择 unique 单元；其回退校验还需要 query。迁移不会隐式补装任何一个单元。
组织 ID 是规范小写 UUID。保存组织视图后，同一视图的提取方法也继续使用该组织。
省略 `org` 选项时，根后端使用零 UUID。memory 的每个插件实例独立，namespace 相同也不会共享数据。组织视图只提供业务操作，没有安装与关闭方法。`dropOrg()` 尝试所有后端；一个失败不撤回其它成功删除，调用方应检查聚合错误。不要把多后端组织删除视为一个全局事务。
非默认组织只获得其后端实际提供的能力。根后端上的自定义 capability 不会自动复制；Feature 的 `api` 方法则经组织视图调用。原生 SQL/SPARQL 不支持组织视图，应使用对应组织化数据接口。
先安装可选 peer `@migaia/log-host` 和 `@migaia/log-plugin-durable`。`storageLogStore()` 是异步工厂，接受宿主或组织视图、后端 ID 和非空 `prefix`，不能传普通 KV 对象。下面追加一条记录，再读取序号与待处理状态。
日志记录与业务键分开；业务枚举、clear 和容量限制不会操作日志。后端必须支持所需日志存储，打开时先恢复已确认状态。独占存储上的同一组织与前缀只允许一个打开句柄；支持共享事务的存储可允许多个句柄。序号不因截断而重用。写入是否提交无法确认时，日志停止接纳操作，应关闭后重新打开恢复。`dropOrg()` 后旧日志句柄报 `STORE_DISPOSED`。

打开日志不等于开启自动业务日志。自动记录需要 `createStorageHost({ plugins: [storageJournalPlugin(options), backend] })`；`options` 可以直接提供 `{ logger, namespace, ... }`，或用异步初始化函数为每个组织准备配置。初始化函数接收 `orgId` 和异步 `storageLogStore(id, { prefix })`。宿主借用 logger，不负责 shutdown。

根据需要选择 binlog、WAL、undo 与同事务日志对象。`atomicBinlog` / `atomicUndo` 按后端 ID 指定真实日志存储；需要它们与业务后端能在同一事务提交。其它组合是否可用由实际后端支持决定，不支持会在业务修改前拒绝。外置 binlog 追加失败会报告，已提交业务数据不回滚；结果未知不能通过盲目重放写入恢复。undo 先检查记录与修订，冲突为 `UNDO_CONFLICT`，缺失为 `UNDO_NOT_FOUND`。

开启 `telemetry: true` 还需要 logger 的 level 插件；日志可能包含操作 payload 和错误，应按应用要求配置 logger。只开 telemetry 也会安装异步阶段，此时使用异步数据方法；同步读写会报 `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`。没有导入 `/plugins/journal` 时，宿主运行时不加载 logger。更多 logger 配置见 logger 指南。
业务失败会通过调用的 Promise 返回；观察监听器和报告回调的失败不改变已完成的数据操作。配置 `report(error)` 接收这类诊断，检查 `source`、`code` 和原始 `cause`。

旧版 `.index(...).requirePushdown()` 在没有客户端步骤时允许全表扫描。现在显式索引来源若为 `fullScan`，或原生索引准备遇到竞争而只能扫描，终端读取会拒绝 `@migaia/storage-contract / QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE`。需要原生索引时同时装配 `entityIndexesFeature()` 和后端索引 Feature；允许权威扫描时移除 `requirePushdown()`。普通查询继续保留扫描回退。IndexedDB 的借用视图与原生 store 共用能力身份；未迁移的旧格式记录使 readiness 保持 running；查询继续全表扫描并发出回退诊断，直到迁移状态完成且与当前定义一致。

没有迁移元数据时，只有从 canonical 起点开始、完整结束两个扫描阶段，且未遇到任何旧格式记录、未跳过任何无效 entity 记录的回填，才可变为 complete。当前格式数据因此无需 `entityMigrationFeature()` 也可使用原生 cursor。旧格式记录（含已有 canonical 副本的 shadow）或被跳过的无效记录使 readiness 保持 running；普通查询全表扫描并发出回退诊断，显式索引 strict 查询拒绝 `QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE`。从持久 checkpoint 续跑不能证明前面的扫描干净。已有迁移元数据仍只接受 complete 状态和匹配的 schema fingerprint。

Bring memory, database and file backends into one storage host, select each through typed `backend(id)` calls, and finish storage work with one cleanup entry point. Use it when an application needs several data sources, organization isolation or transactions: install the relevant plugins, then select the capabilities each backend provides. Writes across separate backends do not automatically form one atomic transaction.

items: Plugin IDs must be unique. A batch becomes visible only after every installation succeeds; failed installation releases resources created by that batch. Overlapping `use` and `unUse` calls queue in call order; each starts after the previous one settles, whether it succeeded or failed.

`autoDetect` defaults to `true`; `installTimeoutMs` defaults to `30000` and limits each plugin's install separately (plugins in one batch are timed individually); `0` disables it. With `autoDetect: false`, call `await host.detect()` before data operations. Operations whose checks are unfinished reject with `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`. Check newly added backends after `use()` as well.

The default `org` is the zero UUID. Explicit IDs must be canonical lowercase UUIDs; `createOrgId()` generates one. An organization view cannot install plugins, drop organizations or close the host. `dropOrg()` attempts every backend; successful deletions remain if another fails. `ORG_DELETE_FAILED` exposes the failures through `AggregateError.errors`.

Capabilities depend on the actual backend instance. A non-default organization does not automatically inherit a custom capability attached only to the root backend; check `has(token)`. Native SQL/SPARQL entry points are unavailable through organization views.

Explicit `dispose()` rejects on cleanup failure and reuses its Promise on repeated calls. `await using` cleanup reports failures and completes so it does not replace a primary business error. See each backend's guide for closing caller-supplied native clients.
Host errors use `source: 'storage.host'`. Shared argument and capability errors come from `storage.contract`. Inspect `source`, `code` and `cause` together rather than matching message text.

blocks.text: Subpaths are consolidated: the former `/authoring/*` and `/vector/mmr` entries are merged into `/sdk`; `/journal` becomes `/plugins/journal`; `/entity/<name>` becomes `/entity/features/<name>`; the memory backend moves from the root entry to `/plugins/memory`. The old paths are removed with no aliases.

Applications that only call `backend()` do not need authoring tools. Backend implementations now import runtime tools from these entries; types, capability tokens, definitions and pure validators remain in contract.
Paths beginning `/sdk` below are prefixed with `@migaia/storage-host`.

rows: Key encoding, input snapshots and resources

blocks.text: See storage-contract for full paths and dependencies. The old contract root no longer exports these runtime tools.

Entity assembly changes: `/entity` provides basic reads/writes. Previously automatic query, indexes, unique checks, migration and keyset now require their own `/entity/*` units in `features`. Import only the units used by the application; missing units throw `ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED`. See entity setup.

The base host does not import journal runtime, notification controllers or change iterators. Previously the host's journal option loaded logging automatically and memory enabled notifications and watch by default. Applications now select these capabilities so basic reads and writes do not include unused code.

Journal configuration goes into `storageJournalPlugin(options)` from `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/journal`, placed in the first `createStorageHost` plugin batch before the backends it records; the host has no separate `journal` option. A configured journal plugin installed later, or passed twice, rejects with `INVALID_CONFIG`. For `storageLogStore()` alone, install `storageJournalPlugin()` without options; missing assembly raises `JOURNAL_NOT_ASSEMBLED`. Journal configuration, stored records and transaction semantics retain their existing contract.

Observation events are subscribed only through `storageProbe(handlers)` from `@migaia/storage-host/plugins/probe`; the host has no `hooks` option and no `host.hooks`. A probe in the `createStorageHost` plugins receives events from the first install event of that batch. After installation, `host.extensions.observe(name, handler)` adds a listener and returns its unsubscribe function; on a view of a non-default organization it receives only that organization's events. A host has at most one probe. Listener failures go to `report` and never change storage results.
Memory notifications and feeds use separate Feature roots:

Without the feed Feature, memory reports `capabilities.changeFeed: false` and watch raises `CHANGE_ITERATOR_NOT_ASSEMBLED`. Notifications alone enable `subscribeChanges()`. The feed requires notifications; omitting them raises `CHANGE_CONTROLLER_NOT_ASSEMBLED`. A lightweight lifecycle owner still closes physical resources and drains accepted writes.

Backend authors import the controller factory from `/sdk` and pass it explicitly to `core.createChangeController(options, createBackendChangeController)`. Basic physical resources can use `createBackendLifecycleController` from that entry. Change iterators come from the same `/sdk` entry.

Previously, `.index(...).requirePushdown()` allowed a full scan when no client steps remained. Terminal reads now reject `@migaia/storage-contract / QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE` when an explicit index source plans `fullScan`, or native preparation contention leaves only a scan.

Install `entityIndexesFeature()` and the backend index Feature when native execution is required. Remove `requirePushdown()` when an authoritative scan is acceptable. Ordinary queries retain their scan fallback.

IndexedDB borrowed views resolve the same private capabilities as their native store. Legacy records keep readiness running until migration completes with the matching schema fingerprint. Queries continue to scan and report fallback while readiness is not complete.

blocks.text: Put initial plugins in `plugins`. A later `use()` returns a host type that includes the new backends. Both references share one lifetime; close either host reference once.

Plugins in one batch cannot borrow each other's unpublished backends. Install base backends first, then install a cache, archive or other composed plugin with `use()`. IDs must be unique throughout the host.

`autoDetect` defaults to `true`. Set it to `false` when configuration must finish before checks, then explicitly call `detect()`. Concurrent checks share their Promise; successful checks are cached and failed checks can be retried. `installTimeoutMs` bounds the entire install batch in milliseconds, defaults to `30000`, and accepts finite nonnegative numbers. Failed installation rolls back that batch's resources without deleting previously installed backends.

The memory backend can write strings, bytes and records in one transaction. A failed callback does not commit its draft. Obtain queries through the `records` capability; this example reads committed data after the transaction finishes.

Memory filters records on the client. With a database backend, pushdown and transaction scope depend on that backend. Conflict handling may replay a transaction callback. Keep email, payments and other effects that cannot roll back outside it.

Strings, bytes and records have channel-conflict rules for the same logical key. Choose the appropriate write policy when replacing another channel. Do not treat these channels as unrelated key spaces. Duplicate batch-write keys reject before commit; duplicate deletion keys count once.

`/entity` provides definition, connection and basic reads/writes. Optional operations require explicit subpath units. Missing units throw `ENTITY_FEATURE_REQUIRED` with `source: @migaia/storage-host` and name the required import.

Select only required units in `features`: `entityQueryFeature()` from `/entity/features/query` adds query/list/stream; `entityIndexesFeature()` from `/entity/features/indexes` adds index declaration/planning; `entityUniqueFeature()` from `/entity/features/unique` adds unique commit checks; `entityMigrationFeature()` from `/entity/features/migration` adds version plans and persisted migration; `entityKeysetFeature()` from `/entity/features/keyset` admits page/after. Index-backed queries and fallback uniqueness validation also require query. Migration without indexes or unique constraints scans native records or text keys directly and needs neither query nor unique. Units never enable another unit implicitly.
The unique unit captures its own constraint projections without enabling index planning. Unique write checks alone do not require the indexes unit.
`defineEntity<T>()({...})` declares an object's primary key and indexes. `connect(store)` attaches it to a backend. This example writes first, then queries through the same definition.

The repository does not close its backend. Use `orders.in(tx)` inside a transaction; `orders.batch(...)` uses one native record transaction. Schemas and codecs perform runtime validation and conversion; TypeScript types alone do not validate external input. `fromStandardSchema` is available from the same `/entity` entry. Conversion failures retain the original error through `cause`.

Select `index` or `range` first and only once. `where`, `select`, `skip` and `limit` create new query branches. Pair custom comparators with a finite `limit`, or use `first()`. `stream()` returns a disposable iterator; use `await using` or explicit `dispose()` if stopping early. When available, `watch()` supplies invalidation notifications, not result rows or reliable replay. Transaction queries do not expose `watch()`.

Select only migration when upgrading records without indexes or unique constraints. Reading an old record upgrades the returned value; call `migrate()` to persist the new envelopes. Each memory-record batch uses the original native transaction.
Declaring unique constraints still requires the unique unit. Its fallback check also requires query; migration does not supply either unit implicitly.
Organization IDs are canonical lowercase UUIDs. Saving an organization view, including extracting one of its methods, keeps that organization fixed.

Without an `org` option, the root backend uses the zero UUID. Each memory plugin instance is independent even if namespaces match. Organization views provide business operations without installation or shutdown methods. `dropOrg()` attempts every backend; a failure does not reverse successful deletions elsewhere. Inspect the aggregate error rather than treating organization deletion as a cross-backend transaction.

A non-default organization receives the capabilities its backend actually provides. A custom capability on the root backend is not copied automatically; Feature `api` methods are routed through the organization view. Native SQL/SPARQL entry points do not support organization views; use the relevant organized data APIs.

Install the optional `@migaia/log-host` and `@migaia/log-plugin-durable` peers first. `storageLogStore()` is asynchronous and accepts a host or organization view, a backend ID and a nonempty `prefix`. A plain KV object is not accepted. Append one record, then inspect its sequence and pending state:

Log records are separate from business keys. Business enumeration, clear and capacity limits do not touch them. A backend must support the required log storage; opening it first recovers confirmed state. Exclusive storage permits one open handle for an organization and prefix, while shared transactional storage may permit several. Truncation does not reuse sequence numbers. An unconfirmed write stops further operations: close and reopen the log to recover. Old log handles reject with `STORE_DISPOSED` after `dropOrg()`.

Opening a log does not enable automatic business logging. Configure `createStorageHost({ plugins: [storageJournalPlugin(options), backend] })` for that. `options` supplies `{ logger, namespace, ... }` directly, or is an asynchronous initializer for each organization. The initializer receives `orgId` and asynchronous `storageLogStore(id, { prefix })`. The host borrows the logger and does not shut it down.

Choose binlog, WAL, undo and same-transaction log stores as needed. `atomicBinlog` / `atomicUndo` select real log stores by backend ID and require a shared transaction with the business backend. Other combinations depend on backend support and reject before business mutation when unavailable. Failed external binlog appends are reported without rolling back committed business data. Do not recover unknown results by blindly replaying writes. Undo checks stored data and revisions first; conflicts use `UNDO_CONFLICT`, and missing history uses `UNDO_NOT_FOUND`.

`telemetry: true` additionally requires the logger level plugin. Logs can include operation payloads and errors; configure the logger for the application's needs. Even telemetry-only configuration installs an asynchronous stage, so use asynchronous data methods; synchronous reads and writes reject with `ASYNC_STAGE_IN_SYNC_ENTRY`. Without a `/plugins/journal` import, the host does not load logger at runtime. See the logger guide for logger configuration.

Business failures reject the operation's Promise. Observer and reporting-callback failures do not change completed data operations. Use `report(error)` for these diagnostics and inspect `source`, `code` and the original `cause`.

When no migration metadata exists, a backfill that starts from the canonical beginning and finishes both scan phases may become complete only if it observes no legacy records and skips no invalid entity records. Current-format records can then use the native cursor without `entityMigrationFeature()`.

Legacy records, including canonical shadows, and skipped invalid records keep readiness running; ordinary queries scan and report fallback, while explicit indexed strict queries reject `QUERY_NOT_PUSHABLE`. Resuming from a persisted checkpoint does not prove the earlier scan was clean. Existing migration metadata still requires status complete and the matching schema fingerprint.
